body:
## Outcome
Build evidence & data trust for the open-source Product Truth Engine and Catalog Maintenance Agent.

## Phase
Agentic MVP: evidence-backed reports only

## Scope
- [x] Field-level provenance: source URL, observed timestamp, excerpt or structured pointer, extraction method and evidence ID.
- [x] Explicit unknown values and field-specific source precedence; preserve conflicting observations.
- [ ] Persistence and retrieval of evidence; retention controls and distinction between model score and validated confidence.

## Acceptance criteria
- [x] Every extracted factual field can reference retrievable evidence or is explicitly marked unsupported.
- [x] Conflicting supplier/manufacturer values remain inspectable with a resolution explanation.
- [ ] Provenance survives export and persistence round trips.

## Dependencies
None; foundation work can start independently.

## Planning estimate
3–5 focused engineering days for one engineer, assisted by AI, after dependencies are ready. This is a preliminary estimate, not a delivery commitment; external integrations, evaluation results and deployment requirements may change it. Break this epic into reviewable child issues before implementation.

## Definition of done
- [ ] Acceptance criteria demonstrated with meaningful automated checks and an end-to-end example.
- [ ] Public APIs, migration notes and operating limitations documented.
- [ ] Existing extraction/comparison/monitoring compatibility checked where affected.
- [ ] Core implementation, tools and workflows remain MIT open-source and self-hostable; no paid feature gate.

## Boundaries
Do not expand this epic into the other roadmap workstreams. Managed hosting/support may be offered separately. Do not mark the epic complete solely because a demo or MCP wrapper exists.

## Spec Kit implementation breakdown

Next after closed Epic 1 (#21). This breakdown follows [Spec Kit's specify → plan → tasks workflow](https://github.com/github/spec-kit). The shared Spec Kit planning artifacts are initialized in `specs/002-evidence-data-trust/` through merged #34; dependent implementations maintain the shared spec, plan and task mappings.

### Shared requirements
- FR-01: Field-level evidence includes retrievable source URL, UTC observation time, captured excerpt or pointer into retained data, method and evidence ID, including nested variant facts.
- FR-02: Missing/default/unsupported values are explicit; zero and false can be supported facts; normalization preserves original observations and transformations.
- FR-03: Versioned field-specific authority resolves observations deterministically and retains conflicts with explanations.
- FR-04: Evidence persistence/retrieval and conservative migration preserve identity/history without manufacturing historical support.
- FR-05: A portable lossless export/load contract preserves evidence and resolution; restricted formats have documented companion bundles.
- FR-06: Model/rule scores stay separate from validated confidence; validation metadata is required for confidence claims.
- FR-07: Bounded evidence capture and explicit retention expose expired/unavailable support without silent dangling claims.

### Ordered child issues
- [x] #34 — Specify field evidence, unknown states and trust contracts. Depends on: none.
- [x] #35 — Capture field provenance across extractors and normalization. Depends on: #34.
- [x] #36 — Resolve field sources deterministically and preserve conflicts. Depends on: #34, #35.
- [ ] #37 — Persist retrievable evidence with explicit retention and migration. Depends on: #34, #35.
- [ ] #38 — Preserve evidence and resolutions in portable exports. Depends on: #35, #36, #37.
- [ ] #39 — Demonstrate evidence trust end to end and document compatibility. Depends on: #36, #37, #38.

Implementation order: #34 → #35 → #36 and #37 → #38 → #39. Execute sequentially by default under the bounded-usage preference.

All six are native GitHub sub-issues. The epic remains open until the remaining child acceptance criteria and end-to-end verification are complete.


## Implementation status — 2026-10-16

- #34 completed and closed via merged PR #41: field evidence/unknown-state contracts and shared planning artifacts.
- #35 completed and closed via merged PR #42: extraction/normalization provenance, bounded captures and platform/authentication follow-ups.
- #36 completed and closed via merged PR #43: versioned field authority/freshness, retained conflicts, deterministic resolution and matching evidence references. CI passed on Python 3.10/3.11/3.12.
- #37 remains open: evidence persistence/retrieval, conservative migration and retention. Its #34/#35 prerequisites are merged.
- #38 remains open: portable Product/evidence bundles and restricted-format sidecars, following #36/#37.
- #39 remains open: complete extraction → resolution → persistence/restart → export/load verification and final epic acceptance.

PR #43 validation: 590 offline tests passed; GitHub CI passed on Python 3.10/3.11/3.12. Live resolution matrix: 12 cases across six supported families and seven sites, with five independent API/HTML pairs. Both notebooks and README/docs are updated; eight new offline notebook cells executed and all 63 code cells syntax-checked. Full network-dependent notebooks were not rerun.

Reports: [field resolution](https://github.com/umerkhan95/shopextract/blob/main/docs/field-resolution.md), [live review](https://github.com/umerkhan95/shopextract/blob/main/artifacts/field-resolution-live/review.md). Live sample success does not close the persistence/export/end-to-end acceptance gates.
